fields.summary: Document the Jira to GitHub automation in the README

content.text: What's Needed: Update README.md to explain the automation workflows in this repo: what triggers each one, what it does, and what needs to be configured (runner, secrets) for it to work.
Why / Context: New team members are setting up Jira automation rules and don't know which events to send or which secrets must exist in the repo.
Known Constraints: Documentation only. Do not change any workflow files. Keep it to roughly one page.
